stories.title: SpaceX's Starship reaches orbit for first time before crashing on return
new_facts: Starship exploded upon slamming into the Pacific Ocean after completing an orbital test flight Monday.
14th Starship test flight achieved orbit and splashed down in the Pacific before noon Monday.
Starship launched from a Spaceport in South Texas before entering Earth's orbit.
First flight to boost the upper stage to orbit, called a milestone for both SpaceX and NASA.
Starship's success is tied specifically to NASA's Artemis moon program.
Starship reached orbit despite suffering an engine failure during the flight.
Launch occurred at 7:48am local time from Starbase, Texas, marking first attempt to circle Earth.
Starship deployed 26 Starlink satellites, joining 11,000 in service, aiming for six orbits of Earth.
stories.line: SpaceX's Starship completed its first orbital flight test today, though the rocket was destroyed during reentry into the ocean.

stories.title: Trump announces $15 billion steel plant for Iowa, with production set for 2030
new_facts: Trump to announce $15B steel mill in Iowa on Monday, a brand-new story
Builder named as Mesabi Metallics; first mega-steel plant built in US since 1960s
Called largest-ever US steel plant; won't produce first steel until 2030 at earliest
Plant expected to create 1,750 permanent jobs in Iowa
stories.line: Trump announces a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa expected to employ 1,750 people and produce 10 million tons annually by 2030.

Meta hires MongoDB CEO to lead enterprise AI push; MongoDB stock plummets
new_facts: Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead new Meta Enterprise Platform unit, reporting to Zuckerberg.
Desai's new title is Chief Enterprise Platform Officer; MongoDB names Dev Ittycheria interim CEO.
AI leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Meta warn of an 'intelligence explosion' and call for oversight of automated AI research.
Zuckerberg unveils Meta Enterprise Platform as a 'next major pillar' of the business; MongoDB shares fall over 20%.
stories.line: Meta recruits MongoDB's CEO to lead new enterprise AI unit; MongoDB stock drops 20% on the leadership loss.

stories.title: DA reopens Cornell fraternity rape investigation as Trump weakens Title IX
new_facts: First report: 2024 alleged Cornell fraternity rape investigation has been reopened
Trump admin rescinded 2024 Title IX rule same day investigation reopened
Names Chi Phi fraternity, seven accused members, outcry over leniency, victim's civil lawsuit
Cornell issues statement supporting reopened investigation
stories.line: A district attorney is reopening a criminal investigation into alleged gang rape at a Cornell fraternity after the Trump administration weakened Title IX enforcement rules.

stories.title: Pope concludes France visit with statements on war, migration, abuse
new_facts: Introduces Pope Leo XIV's four-day France visit as deeply political, per Vatican correspondent Colleen Dulle.
Names event 'At the Roots of Europe for Peace and Unity' and attendee Princess Charlene of Monaco.
Vatican frames environmental destruction as an 'ecological sin'; notes 2022 Paris climate agreement signing.
Pope's closing speech warns against 'desire for domination' driving wars, calls trip's most political moment.
Pope's Metz speech invokes Robert Schuman and EU founding values of equality and rule of law.
Pope decries 'scourge' of sexual abuse, praises bishops' 'courageous' steps, ahead of Lourdes meeting with survivors.
Pope warns relations between nations are 'increasingly uncivilised', citing 'lies and deceit'.
Macron urges Europe to recall 'courage of its founders' against 'resurgence of nationalism' at Metz event.
stories.line: Pope Leo concludes a France visit marked by public positions on war, migration, abuse, and environmental destruction.

stories.title: FBI deputy director overseeing election work steps down
new_facts: New story: FBI co-Deputy Director Andrew Bailey resigns after roughly a year in a newly created leadership post.
Adds Bailey's on-record resignation statement, his role in a Georgia election center raid, and names AG Todd Blanche and FBI Director Kash Patel.
Names Dan Bongino as the prior Deputy Director alongside Bailey and states Bailey joined the FBI in September 2025.
stories.line: FBI Deputy Director Andrew Bailey, who oversaw election-related investigations, has resigned after one year.

stories.title: Five men released on bail in suspected RAF Fairford terror plot
new_facts: First report: 5 men arrested near a UK air base used by US forces, suspected of preparing terrorist act.
Names the base as RAF Fairford; suspects released on bail; quotes police statement.
Van material found 'not viable explosives'; suspects identified as British nationals from London; Iran denies involvement.
UK Foreign Secretary vows to act against Iran's proxies amid plot investigation.
Police say offences may have been committed knowingly or unknowingly for a foreign state.
Trump comments that suspects intended 'big damage' to RAF Fairford.
stories.line: Five men arrested on suspicion of planning an attack on a U.S.-used British air base have been released on bail; police say material found was not viable explosives.

stories.title: Trump administration reverses Biden fuel economy and Title IX rules
new_facts: Trump admin rolls back Biden fuel economy standards; new mpg target 34.9 by 2031 vs 50.4 prior
Linda McMahon rescinds Biden's 2024 Title IX rule, restoring Trump-era rules on girls' sports and gender identity
stories.line: Trump administration reverses two major Biden policies on vehicle emissions and student civil rights protections.

stories.title: U.S. and China cut reciprocal tariffs on $30 billion in goods each
new_facts: White House releases reciprocal '30-for-30' product lists for reduced US-China tariffs
US and China cut reciprocal tariffs on ~$30bn of goods each, excluding strategic goods
stories.line: U.S. and China agreed to cut reciprocal tariffs on $30 billion each in goods, removing duties on items from foie gras to electronics.
